thresholds.scope: L3 synthetic known-family experiments. Thresholds are acceptance criteria, never fitted to outcomes.

measurement_contract.training: Only first .45s position/angle/level samples; contact calibration uses separate .7s / 1.1s training episodes. Geometry and orientation-derived spin are observable inputs.
measurement_contract.validation: Two distinct episode seeds, never used to revise a frozen model.
measurement_contract.test: Three distinct seeds per scene; test observations requested only after freezing model hashes.
measurement_contract.independence: Separate initial conditions and seed ranges, shared known simulator family. This is not model-family independence or a real-world test.
measurement_contract.uncertainty: 24 deterministic initial-state perturbations, +/-5mm and +/-0.02m/s; descriptive confidence conditional on those assumptions, not calibrated sensor uncertainty.
measurement_contract.contacts: Ground, board, rim, net and sphere contacts are permitted task events. Obstacle/planet/wall contacts are forbidden in controlled runs. A deliberate obstacle probe is a positive detector control, excluded from safe-flight counts.

scenes.family: quadratic drag, constant gravity/wind, Magnus; restitution/Coulomb contacts; PBD net with fixed material prior

contact_probes.classification: deliberate positive control of forbidden-collision detector

scenes.family: equal-mass spheres with restitution and floor friction
double pendulum with known measured lengths and estimated gravity/mass ratio
uniform tank volume balance, not general fluid simulation
